step.code:
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Invoicing;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\User;

class InvoiceCreationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    /**
     * @test
     * ** Verifies that an authenticated user can create a new invoice.
     */
    public function itCreatesAnInvoice(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)
            ->postJson(route('invoices.store'), [
                'title'    => 'Test Invoice',
                'due_date' => now()->addDays(30)->toDateString(),
            ]);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('invoices', ['title' => 'Test Invoice']);
    }

    /**
     * @test
     * ** Verifies that validation rejects missing required fields.
     */
    public function itRejectsInvalidData(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($user)
            ->postJson(route('invoices.store'), []);

        $response->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJsonValidationErrors(['title', 'due_date']);
    }
}

step.description: Run the test to confirm it passes.
